system.description: Until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery, you use your telekinesis to augment your physical actions. When you roll on a task using brute force, such as moving a heavy object or smashing down a door, and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Action to initiate.
